prompt: Composition: Single reading column, left aligned headings, marginal metadata, thin section rules. Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Set headings in Junicode and reading text in Aileron; humanist reading serif with economical sans text. Use Spectrum 1-4: page #F9F9FB, text #251F2D, accent #861D85, secondary surface #EFEAE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 14px, heading 80px, line height 1.3, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 32px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
